# ona_git_authentication (List Resource)

Lists importable PAT-backed service-account Git authentications without retrieving PAT values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "ona_git_authentication" "service_account" {
  provider         = ona
  include_resource = true

  config {
    service_account_id = "01980ed3-a090-7b5b-a74c-9bf5d8cfe53c"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `scm_integration_id` (String) PAT-enabled SCM integration ID to include.
- `service_account_id` (String) Service account ID to include.
